subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload path, and what storage, validation, auth scope, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The request is useful, but it crosses a new file-upload and workspace-write boundary, so automation should not choose the security model or source-of-truth policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded upload design
options.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and keeps the existing read-only avatar route protections.

options.title: Keep existing manual and browser-local paths
options.body: Continue supporting config/CLI/IDENTITY.md avatar values plus the browser-local Quick Settings override while avoiding new server-side upload risk.

options.title: Defer core upload
options.body: Leave this open or close later under a broader Control UI identity-management design rather than adding a one-off upload endpoint now.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload design
recommendation.body: Add a narrow authenticated upload path that stores validated image files under the agent workspace, updates canonical identity metadata, and keeps the existing read-only avatar route protections.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for avatar serving and hardening is the Peter Steinberger-authored avatar support and security-hardening commits.
